description: PDF to images. Turn PDF pages into JPG or PNG — one image per page. Handy when the document has to be shown where PDF is not opened. Accepts application/pdf, .pdf; up to 100 MB per file.

dpi.description: Resolution: 150 for screens and messengers, 300 for print and OCR, 72 for a quick look

format.description: Image format: JPG is lighter, PNG is sharper on text and diagrams

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

pages.description: Which pages: 1-3, 7, 10-12. Empty means the whole document

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: pdf_to-image
